messages.subject: geom_history()
parts:
Hi there,
 
I am trying to create a histogram plot using the variation geom="lines". However, I can't seem to differentiate the lines according to fill= factor(cut). I have tried several ways, but perhaps I am not getting it right at the first place?
 

a<- ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity))
line <- a + stat_bin(aes(ymax=..count..,fill=factor(cut),group=cut), geom="line",binwidth=0.1, position="identity")
line
 
or
 
a<- ggplot(diamonds, aes(clarity, fill=factor(cut)))
line <- a + stat_bin(aes(ymax=..count..,group=cut), geom="line",binwidth=0.1, position="identity")
line
 
Either way, the frequency is not represented with the factor(cut).
Some help would be appreciated.
Thanks
Aiden

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: geom_history()
parts:
geom_line doesn't use the aesthetic 'fill', so fill=factor(cut) has no
effect. (Note that cut is already a factor in the dataset.) Do you
mean colour=cut?

Ben
